subject.title: [Bug]: Fallback model does not report progress correctly during long tasks

question: Should OpenClaw guarantee channel-visible intermediate progress parity across model fallback candidates, including cross-provider fallbacks with different streaming and tool-progress behavior?
rationale: The code has multiple progress surfaces and related fallback visibility reports point in different directions, so automation should not choose the user-visible audience or parity contract on its own.

options.title: Guarantee parity in core
options.body: Treat fallback attempts as the same user-visible progress contract as primary attempts and fix the shared progress plumbing with source and live proof.

options.title: Document degraded fallback progress
options.body: Guarantee only final delivery and explicit fallback notices when a provider or runtime cannot support equivalent intermediate progress.

options.title: Fold into durable status work
options.body: Keep this as a symptom under broader durable channel status and fallback delivery semantics instead of adding a narrower progress repair now.

recommendation.title: Guarantee parity in core
recommendation.body: Treat fallback attempts as the same user-visible progress contract as primary attempts and fix the shared progress plumbing with source and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice centers on the model fallback mechanism and visible fallback notice contract that this history most strongly ties to steipete.
